item.title: Apple iPad Pro M4 Magic Keyboard vs Logitech Combo Touch: Best iPad Keyboard Case
item.description:
iPad Pro M4 Keyboard Cases: Magic Keyboard vs. Logitech Combo Touch

When Apple unveiled the iPad Pro M4 in May 2024, it didn’t just introduce a new processor—it introduced a device that genuinely challenges the laptop paradigm. The new ultra-thin chassis (5.1mm) and the tandem OLED display are impressive, but the accessory ecosystem is what determines whether this tablet can actually replace your MacBook.

The two dominant contenders for turning your iPad Pro into a productivity machine are Apple’s own Magic Keyboard (now in its second generation for the M4) and Logitech’s Combo Touch. Both cost a significant chunk of change, and both promise to transform your tablet experience. But they take fundamentally different approaches to that transformation.

item.title: Sonos Era 300 vs Apple HomePod 2 vs Amazon Echo Studio: Smart Speaker Sound Test
item.description:
Sonos Era 300 vs. Apple HomePod 2 vs. Amazon Echo Studio: Smart Speaker Sound Test

Smart speakers have evolved from convenient voice assistants into serious audio hardware. While the Amazon Echo Studio has dominated the “sounds great for the price” category for years, the arrival of the Sonos Era 300 and the second-generation Apple HomePod has completely changed the competitive landscape. All three devices hover in the $299-$449 price range, but they take radically different approaches to filling a room with sound. After spending two weeks with all three speakers in the same listening space, here is how they stack up.
